title.shows: Two to four giant words fill the frame, every letter springing into place, with a tiny label above them.
for: the title of a film or product
an introduction of what is coming

highlight.shows: A line of big words lands and a marker stroke is swiped behind one of them.
for: a claim with one word that matters
a headline with a highlighted word
a benefit said in one line

swap.shows: A lead phrase stands still while its last word slides out and another springs in inside a coloured pill.

fullbleed.shows: One word in capitals fills the whole frame on a flat colour, or repeats in rows of outlined type.
for: a single word as a punch
a hard accent on a beat

grid.shows: Three to six typographic tiles pop in one after another on half-beats and read together as one sentence.
for: a sentence built word by word in tiles

wall.shows: The camera pulls back from one card to a tilted wall of many cards in 3D.
for: many screenshots or pictures at once
a reveal of scale from one item to many

prompt.shows: A chat box in the middle of the frame: a request is typed into it letter by letter and a cursor clicks send.
for: an opening where somebody asks an AI product for something
the request that starts the story

ui-macro.shows: An extreme close-up of one region of a screenshot where text is typed and a giant cursor clicks.
for: a detail of an interface in close-up
one button or field of a product being used
a click on a real screenshot

ui-float.shows: A screenshot floats as a tilted card over a blurred copy of itself with a caption above it.
for: a product screen shown as a hero
a calm look at the interface

counter.shows: One big number counts up to its value with a label under it.
for: how many users, sales or percent

toggle.shows: A giant switch, checkbox or slider is clicked by a cursor and turns on.

logo3d.shows: The logo turns as a 3D cube, lands flat and the name appears beside it.
for: the brand mark with its name

endcard.shows: The logo and the name assemble and a pill with the call to action, usually the address of the site, lands under them.
for: the last scene of a film
a call to action with a link
logo and URL at the end

slam.shows: A poster stack of short lines: each line slams in on its own beat and the last one echoes, with tiny fragments decoding around it.
for: a few short lines hitting on the beat
lines that slam in one by one

morph.shows: One interface shape morphs through states, a button, a loader, a check, a switch, a slider, a player, tabs, a search field, a toast, one a beat, with a cursor clicking each change.
for: a button that becomes a loader and then a check
a quick tour of interface controls

steps.shows: A progress ring fills while two to four numbered steps land one after another.

ticket.shows: A ticket card types its rows of label and value, then a stamp of one or two words presses down on it.
for: an order, a booking or a receipt
a task marked shipped or approved

marquee.shows: Three ticker bands of big type slide across the frame in opposite directions.
for: a list of what a product does
a call to action as a ticker

phones.shows: Three phones fan out side by side with screens on them and a caption.
for: a mobile app shown on phones
several screens of an app at once

caption.shows: A sentence with one chip inside it; a number in the chip rolls up to its value.
for: a hook with a number in it
a sentence with one highlighted figure

typewriter.shows: Text is typed on a blank page with a human rhythm; the end of it may be erased and typed again as something else.

sentence.shows: A big sentence of up to eight words lands word by word, every other word in a colour.
for: a statement said word by word
a line that carries the story on

append.shows: One fixed word stands still while the word after it changes on every beat.
for: one word with a changing second word
a cycling word on the beat

countdown.shows: The numbers three, two, one hit one a beat, then a word such as LIVE or NOW.

stat.shows: Digits roll to a figure while a trend line draws itself under them.
for: a real number with a rising curve

chart.shows: A line, bar, pie or ring chart draws itself from real numbers.
for: data shown as bars or a line
a share shown as a pie or a ring

timeline.shows: A roadmap line with milestones that land on it one after another.

pricing.shows: A pricing card springs up, its features tick in one by one and a cursor clicks its button.
for: a price and what it includes
an offer with a buy button

globe.shows: A globe of dots turns while arcs fly between points on it.

code.shows: A code editor in which lines of code are typed.
for: an API in a few lines

chat.shows: A chat thread: bubbles pop in one after another with typing dots between them.
for: a dialogue with a product or a person
a tiny story told in a chat

notify.shows: Notifications stack one over another on a dark lock screen.
for: a phone lock screen with messages

dock.shows: A macOS dock of app icons: a cursor sweeps along it magnifying them, clicks one and the camera dives into it.

chaos.shows: Browser windows pile up one over another around a phrase.

laptop.shows: A laptop with a screenshot on its screen; the camera dives into the screen.
for: a web product on a laptop
a screenshot shown on a device
a move from a device into the product

browser.shows: A browser window: the address types into its bar and the page loads.
for: a web page in a browser window

callouts.shows: A screenshot with labelled pills popping out of it and pointing at its parts.
for: features pointed out on a screenshot
what is where on a screen

compare.shows: A before and after: a cursor drags a divider across the frame from one statement to the other.
for: the old way against the new way

journey.shows: The camera travels along one sentence with motion blur as its words arrive, the last word rolls through options like a wheel, then the camera pulls back to show the whole line.
for: a line with a rolling last word

faces.shows: Portraits of real people float at different depths, some out of focus, around a short line.

shuffle.shows: A sentence breaks apart and its words fly in arcs to form the next one; shared words travel, the others blur away or arrive.
for: before and after in one move
a problem rewritten as a solution

overlay.shows: A full-frame photo with one to three glass cards floating over it, the number on each rolling up.
for: a result shown over the user's picture

trail.shows: On black, glowing neon streaks of light sweep round an input pill in which a short line is typed.
for: a striking hook of two seconds
a feature said in one line with light
one tap to pay or send

between.shows: A phone lands in the gap of a sentence, a finger taps through the app on it and the last word of the sentence changes with every tap.
for: a mobile app used inside a sentence
book a table, book a ride

drag.shows: Files lie on a desk and a cursor drags each of them into the product's drop zone, they upload and get ticks, then the cursor clicks a button.
for: feeding documents or footage to a product

knockout.shows: One giant word is cut out of the frame and the product shows through its letters, then the camera dives through a letter until the product fills the frame.
for: a zoom through a word into the product

assemble.shows: A ransom-note word: every letter lands on its own paper scrap in another typeface, then the scraps drop and the letters glide into one quiet serif word.
for: one big idea as a crafted word
a word assembled from cut-out letters

hive.shows: A honeycomb of empty slots opens around the logo, the product's tools fly in and land in the slots, then the hive pulls into the mark.
for: all your tools in one place

scatter.shows: A sentence is spread loose over the frame in small type with little objects dropping into its gaps; then everything flies out but one key word, which glides to the centre and grows.
for: a sentence that ends on one key word
a detailed line reduced to its point

arc.shows: A short line set small and high, with a strip of photos riding an arc under it, the biggest in the middle.
for: photos of people or places with one line

orb.shows: A glowing sphere of the brand's colours breathes while short calm lines take turns under it.

particles.shows: A constellation of drifting dots joined by faint lines flies in, settles into a line of text and tightens into solid type.

wave.shows: A voice player: a live waveform in a pill and, under it, what the voice says appearing word by word, lit as it is spoken.
for: a call or a voice assistant

agent.shows: The product at work: its name with a spinner, tasks arrive one under another and are ticked off, then the header becomes the done line and a result card slides up.
for: a job done step by step by the product

palette.shows: A command bar: a query types into a big search field, the results under it filter as the letters arrive, the selection slides to the match and Enter opens it.
for: a launcher or a command palette

picker.shows: A big grid of icon tiles seen close: a selection ring hops from tile to tile, then one tile lifts out, the rest dim and a line lands under it.
for: templates, themes or emoji to choose from

montage.shows: Full-frame photos cut fast with a slow push on each, and between them short lines set small on plain cards.
for: a brand film about people and the world

web.shows: The product's mark stands in the middle with the words that describe it on rings around it, each joined by a hairline, while the camera turns slowly in 3D.

split.shows: A coloured panel holds one big word that swaps, and beside it a grid of tiles reshuffles with each word.
for: the kinds of output a product makes
a list of categories with pictures

pack.shows: Circles of every size pop in and pack the frame around one word in the biggest circle, then scatter outward.

swarm.shows: Dozens of pictures hang in 3D at every depth while the camera pushes through them, then they fly out past the lens and a line lands in the clearing.

inline.shows: A sentence with gaps between its words in which pictures open and stack up; with screenshots it ends by zooming into the last one.
for: a sentence with pictures inside it
words and images in one line
a line that leads into a screenshot

bubbles.shows: Chat-input pills with the questions people keep asking float in depth, then fly away as the answer is typed in the middle.
for: a problem told as many questions
one answer to all the questions

retype.shows: One big value is typed, then selected and typed over with another, as in an editor.
for: a price or a rate edited

orbit.shows: A calm sentence lands word by word inside thin line-art orbits with dots travelling along them.
for: a calm statement between fast scenes

checklist.shows: A to-do list types in and a cursor ticks every item off.
for: how it works as ticked steps

tiles.shows: A short word on letter tiles that tumble from above and land in a row.
for: a short call such as SHIP IT

mosaic.shows: The frame splits into panels of screenshots and product screens with crosshairs, one big italic word over them all.

photo.shows: A full-frame photo or screenshot slowly pushes in while a caption arrives word by word in its lower third.
for: a picture the user gave shown whole
a quiet moment over an image

stream.shows: A river of screenshots or picture cards pours diagonally past one word in the middle.

roll.shows: A fixed lead and a last word that rolls vertically through options like a slot machine between selection handles.
for: a word that rolls through a list

dot.shows: One ball carries the scene: it drops and bounces into place as the dot of a word, rolls off, floods the frame with colour, morphs through shapes and ends as a dot with words orbiting it.
for: a bouncing ball that leads the eye

flip.shows: A card in the gap of a sentence flips to a new face as the last word rolls to the next one, then the cards fan out and swing into a pinwheel.
for: the range of what a product does
a sentence with a changing picture inside it
several use cases in one line

pullback.shows: Giant typing fills the frame, then the camera pulls back to show it was typed inside the product's input box, chips land on it and a cursor clicks send.
for: how an AI product is used
a reveal of the input box
an opener for a chat or agent product

glass-island.shows: A capsule of optical glass opens into a card with an icon, a title and a line, as a notification does.
for: a short announcement on a glass card

glass-widgets.shows: A panel of optical glass with two to four key figures, each a label and a big number that counts up.
for: key figures of a product or a business

glass-controls.shows: A control panel of optical glass whose switches turn on one after another and whose slider fills.

glass-ask.shows: A drop of glass opens into a prompt bar with a question mark: a question is typed, the send button presses and the panel grows downward with the answer.

glass-lens.shows: A lens of glass glides across a headline and bends its letters as it passes.
for: a headline with a glass lens over it
a title in the liquid glass look
a look closer at a line

glass-ride.shows: Glass scenes one after another with no cut: each grows out of one drop of glass and folds back into it, the drop leaps to the next place and the camera goes after it.
for: several interface moments in one continuous shot
a seamless sequence of glass panels
a story of search, question and result without cuts

glass-steps.shows: A panel of optical glass grows out of a pill and explains a process: its title, then the steps one after another, each a numbered badge and a line.
for: how it works in two to four steps

glass-stepper.shows: A long process walked step by step: up to ten glass pills down a line, the one being done lit, the ones before it ticked, the camera going down the line with it.
for: a checkout or onboarding of many steps

glass-checklist.shows: A panel of optical glass ticks a list off: every item an empty box, a line read word by word and a tick drawn into the box.
for: what is done and what is left

glass-like.shows: A glass button with an icon and a word grows out of a seed, a pointer clicks it, a ripple runs over it and the icon fills with colour.
for: a call to press a button

glass-rating.shows: A panel of optical glass gives a rating: a question or a name, five stars filling with gold up to the rating and a line under them.

glass-message.shows: A panel of optical glass is a message arriving: the sender's picture, their name, the time and what they wrote.

glass-follow.shows: A panel of optical glass with the mark of a social network, a handle and a button that a pointer presses.
for: follow us on a social network
a handle on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube
a subscribe call at the end

glass-call.shows: A panel of optical glass is a call coming in: who calls, a red and a green button with halos on every ring; a pointer accepts and the call's seconds count.

glass-send-prompt.shows: A prompt is typed into a glass composer while the camera follows the caret, then pulls back to show the whole composer, and the prompt is sent with a wave.
for: a prompt written and sent to an AI
a request with a mention and context chips

glass-search.shows: A drop of glass opens into a search field: a cursor clicks it, a query is typed and Enter is pressed.
for: a query typed into a search field

stack.shows: Big single words stack down the frame one a beat; as each lands the ones above dim.

beatwords.shows: One word a beat, each alone and filling the frame, the ground flipping colour on every cut and each word entering another way.
for: a slogan said one word at a time
a hook cut on the beat

underline.shows: One huge word whose letters rise from behind the baseline one after another, and an underline draws under it.
for: a one-word punch after a build

rundown.shows: A list builds one line a beat, each new line the only lit one, then the whole list steps back and a big punch line lands under it.

winner.shows: A card counts its figure up and draws its curve, then three options rise under it and one is chosen: two fade and the winner lifts with a tick.
for: a product that compares and chooses
a decision made for the user

connect.shows: Pills on the left are joined one by one to a single tile on the right by dotted curves that draw themselves, with a light running along each.

chips.shows: A headline with labelled chips all around it at different depths; they come into focus one by one, then fly past the camera.

tabs.shows: A card with three figures in a row: a lit panel hops from one to the next, each figure counts up and the chart under them bends into another shape.
for: three numbers of a product in one shot

dial.shows: A slider whose knob is dragged to a value out of a hundred, a bubble above it counting as it moves and the ticks it passes lighting up.
for: one share or score shown as something moved

gather.shows: Some fifteen hundred dots drifting over the frame fly together into one big word, it holds solid, then bursts and the dots are flung out of the frame.
for: the name formed out of particles
the one word a film is about
the moment before the end card

impact.shows: The drop: a ring of speed lines flies outward and a word slams in behind it, overshoots and springs to rest.
for: the one thing a film announces
a word slammed on the drop of the music
a launch, a sale, a release
the hardest hit of the film

cards3d.shows: Thick glossy cards cascade in one by one in real 3D, tilted in depth and lit like a product render.
for: a list of pains or features with depth

icon3d.shows: The brand's app icon spins in as a glassy 3D tile with glossy shapes orbiting it, and the name lands below.
for: a hero moment for the brand
the scene before the end card

phone3d.shows: One to three phones in real 3D swing round from the side to face the viewer with screenshots on their screens.
for: a mobile app on a 3D phone
a phone turning to the camera

field.shows: A floor of rounded tiles to the horizon in real 3D: a glowing bar sweeps across it, the tiles ripple, a row rises into bars and the camera cranes up over the field.
for: a world rather than a slide
an atmospheric 3D scene with one line

polar.shows: One springy shape morphs through a circle, a triangle, a star and a square with turning echo outlines and smaller copies orbiting it.
for: an abstract identity of a product

letterflip.shows: A short headline arrives letter by letter, each letter turning in perspective and flashing the accent colour on its back before it lands flat.

accordion.shows: Three to five named picture cards breathe like an accordion: a focus travels along them enlarging each in turn.
for: features or stages shown one by one
a row of cards with a moving focus

explode.shows: One flat card tilts into depth and separates into three to five named layers, turns slowly while they are held apart, then closes again.
for: layers of a product or a stack

scan.shows: A band of light scans a sheet of objects, a label and corner brackets appear on each as the band crosses it, then the objects fly into category cards.
for: a scan of a photo or a document

before-after-wipe.shows: A divider crosses the frame and reveals the after picture over the before picture, labels on both sides.
for: an edit, a retouch or a renovation compared

screen-flow-carousel.shows: A rail of screens: it throws to the next screen and catches it gently while the neighbours step back, a label beside each.
for: a walk through the screens of an app

chart-story.shows: A chart of bars, a line, a donut or a progress bar builds, its labels arrive and one exact figure is singled out.
for: one number out of several emphasised

testimonial-proof-card.shows: A quote rises line by line, its author appears with a portrait, and an underline is drawn under the words that matter.

thinking-orb.shows: A cloud of particles moves as a thinking mind does, working, searching, solving, listening, composing, with a title and a line under it.

modal-morph.shows: A compact card grows into a full panel in one move, its title staying in place while the body and the button arrive.
for: a detail opened from a card
an offer expanded with its button

ride.shows: One white ball rides through real controls in one continuous camera move: it flips a switch, drags a slider, presses a button, ticks a box and steps a number up, then the camera pulls back over all of them.
for: a tour of settings in one shot
controls used one after another without a cut

lens-wall.shows: An endless wall of pictures and videos under a lens: whatever is in the centre swells and the rest curves away like the side of a sphere while the camera crosses the wall.
for: a gallery of the user's photos and videos

laptop3d.shows: A real 3D laptop lies closed, a hand lifts its lid, the screen wakes with the user's picture or video and the camera pulls back.
for: a product opened on a laptop
a website or an app on a real device

synth3d.shows: A pocket beat machine in real 3D in half darkness: two hands come in and play its lit pads one after another, each press a hit.
for: a moment that shows the rhythm

comic.shows: A paragraph glitches in word by word like a comic on the press: each word flickers through colour panels and halftone dots, its colours out of register, then settles into the line.
for: a quote or a manifesto read whole
a punchy statement of a sentence or two

kinetic-swap-words.shows: A short line is edited before the viewer: the words standing out of place glow, lift off, are carried behind a caret and dropped where they belong; a strip of the film's clip may open between the words.
for: words put in the right order
a line that opens into footage

kinetic-spin-words.shows: A short line spins in real 3D: its letters stand on a ring that turns a few fast times under a camera and slows into place on a beat.
for: a short phrase arriving with a whirl

kinetic-burst-words.shows: A short line arrives large and glowing, snaps together solid on a beat, then its letters break into thick 3D pieces that fly at the camera until the frame is black.
for: a line that explodes at the viewer
the last words before a cut to black
a call such as Share it
